summary: Tested the 3 enhancements (print ledger, morning reminder wa.me card, returning-patient reuse) plus regression. Backend: extended /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py with 4 new returning-patient tests; full suite 40/40 passed (pytest -n 0). Frontend (Playwright, public preview URL): new-phone signup still shows name/place/address and registers; returning phone shows 'സ്വാഗതം, <name>' welcome-back banner with name/place/address hidden and verifies with OTP only -> /patient; clinic dashboard btn-print present, clickable and calls window.print() exactly once; print media emulation confirmed (.no-print + header + morning-reminder hidden, .print-only clinic header visible, ledger table visible); morning-reminder card renders with wa.me href containing URL-encoded 'സുപ്രഭാതം', booking count (2) and first token time (09:00), target=_blank. Regression verified: clinic ledger status update (waiting -> completed persisted), walk-in modal, language toggle (Malayalam <-> English), admin login + dashboard stats/tabs/clinic CRUD rows, patient booking slot selection & confirm bar. No console errors, no error elements on any tested page.

minor.issue: Super-admin password is compared in plaintext against SUPER_ADMIN_PASSWORD env (no bcrypt hash, no constant-time compare, no brute-force lockout). bcrypt hash_pw/verify_pw helpers exist but are unused for the admin path. Playbook checks (bcrypt $2b$ hash, httpOnly cookie, 5-fail lockout) do not apply to this OTP/bearer-token design — flagging as a security gap, not a functional failure.

allow_origins=["*"] combined with allow_credentials=True is invalid per the CORS spec (browsers reject credentialed wildcard). Harmless today because auth is Bearer-token, but should be an explicit origin list.

issues: Sonner toast renders centered over the TopBar title, partially covering 'ഇന്നത്തെ ലെഡ്ജർ' right after login/actions
Settings link uses ml-auto inside a flex-wrap toolbar, so on 1920px it wraps to its own second row leaving a large gap under the toolbar
Ledger date uses native <input type="date"> browser picker instead of a styled calendar component (acceptable for the low-literacy audience, but inconsistent with the rest of the design system)
Printed ledger drops the status column entirely (action select is the only status carrier), so the paper ledger has no waiting/completed info — consider a print-only status text column

action_items: Optional: hash the super-admin password with bcrypt and add failed-attempt throttling on /api/auth/admin/login
Optional: replace CORS allow_origins=["*"] with an explicit origin list since allow_credentials=True
Optional design polish: toast position over TopBar title; toolbar wrap of the Settings link; print-only status column
critical_code_review_comments: MorningReminderCard derives firstTime from ledger[0].time (lowest token) regardless of status; verified ledger excludes cancelled slots so the count is correct, but a completed/no-show first token will still be advertised as 'first token'. Acceptable for a morning message — noting only.
server.py is 718 lines; consider splitting routers (auth / clinic / admin / public) before it grows further.

test_credentials: Super admin admin@everyday-appointments.app / admin1234 (works, testids: admin-email, admin-password, admin-submit — note NOT admin-login-submit). Demo clinic demo@clinic.example.com via mocked demo_otp. Returning patient +919999900001 (name 'Test Patient').
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 enhancements verified working end-to-end; no blocking issues. Backend suite: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/backend_test.py -v -n 0 (must use -n 0). New tests live in TestPatientAuth (test_request_otp_new_phone_not_returning, test_request_otp_returning_phone_returns_known_fields, test_verify_returning_patient_without_name, test_returning_flag_flips_after_registration). For print testing use await page.emulate_media(media='print') + getComputedStyle checks instead of screenshots, and stub window.print via page.evaluate to assert the click. Correct testids: admin-submit, clinic-<id> (patient home clinic cards), slot-<time>, date-<iso>. Cancel flows need page.on('dialog', d.accept()). Not covered this round: MyBookings cancel re-test, clinic settings break-window edits, mobile (390px) view of the new morning-reminder card.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no defects reproduced. Two initial Playwright failures were my own selector mistakes (admin-login-submit vs admin-submit, clinic-card-* vs clinic-*) and were corrected in the re-run.
